1.kind: Top-level 'and' coordination wrapping the two clauses instead of attaching the 提供 clause as a temporal modifier of the 空袭
1.cause: The annotator treated 当时…提供 as a coordinate clause (op2) and placed 指-01 under an 'and'. The gold has 指-01 as root with 提供-01 as a :temporal of the 空袭. This also moved the temporal/modal anchors onto the wrong nodes.
1.convention: A 当时 (at that time) clause is a :temporal modifier of the event it is anchored to, not a coordinated sentence. A single main predicate should stay the root.

1.kind: 事件 linked to 空袭 by identity-91 instead of :mod
1.cause: The annotator used an identity-91 equation between 事件 and 空袭-01. The gold treats the event-noun 事件 as the head and the modifying event as its :mod.
1.convention: A generic event noun (事件) modified by a descriptive relative clause takes that event as :mod. Do not use identity-91 here.

1.kind: Wrong relation label for 遇袭 under 案 (topic vs mod)
1.cause: The annotator chose :topic for 遇袭 as the modifier of 案. The gold uses :mod.
1.convention: A noun modified by a nominalized event word (X遇袭案) takes it as :mod, not :topic.

1.kind: 车队 role and possessor structure in 遇袭 (ARG1 vs ARG0, :possessor vs :possessor-of)
1.cause: The annotator made 车队 the ARG1 of 遇袭 and linked the organization with :possessor. The gold uses ARG0 for 车队 and the inverse :possessor-of from 车队 to the organization. The annotator also put the identity-91 with 组织 in the first mention rather than the second.
1.convention: An organization that owns an entity is attached with :possessor-of from the owned entity. Each mention of 车队 is a separate node, with its own possessor-of.

1.kind: Reused a single 车队 node (re-entrancy) instead of a separate node in each clause
1.cause: The annotator coreferred the 车队 in 遇袭, 空袭 and 提供 through one variable. The gold uses a separate 车队 for 遇袭 and one for 空袭/提供, with the name repeated.
1.convention: Repeated mentions across separate event clauses are separate nodes, and coreference is handled at document level.

1.kind: Frequency/measure of '3 次' encoded as have-frequency-91 with a stray ARG2 3 instead of :frequency 3 and :unit 次
1.cause: The annotator built a have-frequency-91 reified relation and dropped the classifier 次. The gold uses a plain :frequency 3 plus :unit 次.
1.convention: A number plus a measure word is annotated as :frequency (a number) with the classifier as :unit.

1.kind: Place type and name for 加沙 and 加沙地带 (country-region vs local-region; name tokens; part-of target)
1.cause: The annotator typed 加沙 as country-region. It linked the 中部 city part-of to the same 加沙 node instead of a separate 加沙 地带 local-region with a two-token name. It also did not make 加沙 地带 a name.
1.convention: Sub-national regions such as 加沙 and 加沙地带 are local-region, and a multi-word proper name keeps all its tokens in the name.

1.kind: Aspect of 援助 given as activity instead of process
1.cause: The annotator labeled 援助-01 as activity. The gold has process.

1.kind: Extra aspect and ARG0 on 援助, and extra document-level temporal link
1.cause: The annotator added document-creation-time :overlap 指-01. It also anchored 遇袭 with the date and its overlap with 空袭 differently. In the gold, the date-entity contains 遇袭, and 遇袭 overlaps 空袭.
1.convention: Link the date-entity to the event as :contained. Do not add a DCT relation for the copular or reporting predicate 指.

2.kind: Wrong causal concept: have-reason-91 instead of have-cause-91
2.cause: Annotator chose have-reason-91 (reason/purpose) rather than the causal predicate have-cause-91 for 'X causes Y' with an event cause; ARG2 is the cause in have-cause-91.
2.convention: Causal relations between events (cause致使/导致 effect) are annotated with have-cause-91 (ARG1 effect, ARG2 cause), not have-reason-91.

2.kind: Missing sense numbers on event predicates (身亡, 袭击)
2.cause: Annotator left Chinese event predicates without a sense suffix instead of using -01 for them.
2.convention: Event predicates (verbal or event nouns) get a sense ID such as -01 even when no frame file exists.

2.kind: Missing aspect on the 袭击 event
2.cause: Annotator gave aspect only to 身亡 and omitted it on the event nominal 袭击, which is a completed event.
2.convention: Every event concept, including event nouns, gets an :aspect value (e.g. performance for completed events).

2.kind: Wrong core role: 工作者 as ARG1 instead of ARG0 of 身亡
2.cause: Annotator treated the dying participant as a patient/undergoer (ARG1); gold treats the sole argument of intransitive 身亡 as ARG0.
2.convention: The sole argument of an intransitive event predicate with no frame file is labeled ARG0 (as the subject).

2.kind: Wrong temporal relations: overlap with previous sentence's event instead of the cause–effect ordering and DCT
2.cause: Annotator linked 身亡 to the previous event with :overlap and omitted the relation between cause and result and anchoring to document-creation-time.
2.convention: For a causal construction, the cause event is :after-linked to the result (cause :before effect), and past events are anchored with document-creation-time :before event.

2.kind: Missing modal annotation for 袭击
2.cause: Annotator only gave a full-affirmative for the 身亡 event and ignored the other event 袭击 in the same sentence.
2.convention: Every event concept in the graph gets an author :full-affirmative (or other modal) relation when asserted.

2.kind: Coreference chain errors: over-merged chain and missing 身亡 chain
2.cause: Annotator linked 袭击 with the previous 空袭 event and over-extended the chain to unrelated mentions (各国, other 空袭 mentions), while missing later coreference of the 身亡 events.
2.convention: Only mentions of the same event are chained; later repeated mentions of the same death event should be linked to it.

2.kind: Extra subset-of coreference for later 人员/雇员 to 工作者
2.cause: Annotator inferred subset relations for later general mentions that the gold does not mark.

3.kind: Clause 'X是不可饶恕的' not analyzed as 行为 identity-91 with the coordinated acts; annotator put the 'and' directly as ARG1 of 饶恕 and omitted 行为 and identity-91
3.cause: Annotator dropped the head noun 行为 and attached the coordinated modifier clause directly as the argument of 饶恕-01, instead of equating the head noun with the modifier content via identity-91
3.convention: A relative/appositive clause modifying a head noun like 行为 ('the act of X') is annotated as the head noun with an identity-91 whose ARG2 is the content clause

3.kind: Agent noun 援助者 split into a generic 人 with ARG0-of 援助-01 (plus habitual aspect and extra modal/temporal) instead of keeping the lexical noun 援助者 with 人道 mod
3.cause: Annotator decomposed a nominal agent word into a verb-based relative structure, creating an extra event (援助-01 habitual) not in gold
3.convention: Lexicalized agent nouns (X者) are annotated as single noun concepts, not decomposed into 人 + ARG0-of event

3.kind: 人道 援助 行动 structure: annotator made 援助-01 an ARG1 of 行动-01 with activity aspect and ARG0; gold has 行动 with mod 人道, mod 援助-01 and possessor of the organization; 行动 is not treated as an event with modal/aspect
3.cause: Annotator treated the light noun 行动 as an event predicate with arguments and aspect, and nested 人道 under 援助; gold treats 行动 as a noun with modifiers and possessor
3.convention: Nominal 'X行动' is annotated as a non-event noun with mod and possessor, with no aspect or modal/temporal annotation

3.kind: Place name 加沙地带 typed country-region instead of local-region
3.cause: Annotator chose the wrong named-entity type; gold uses local-region for Gaza Strip, which also broke the coref chain with earlier mentions
3.convention: Sub-national geographic areas such as the Gaza Strip are typed local-region

3.kind: Temporal 后 clause placed under 宣布 as :temporal; gold attaches it to the top-level and, with 发生 having ARG0 the 事件 (coreferent to 空袭 event)
3.cause: Annotator attached the 后 phrase locally to the nearest event rather than at the top-level coordination scope covering the whole sentence
3.convention: A sentence-initial temporal 后 clause that scopes over the whole coordination is attached at the top-level of the coordination

3.kind: Coordination structure differs: annotator nested and(and(宣布,指出), and(表示,谴责)); gold uses a flat three-way and
3.cause: Annotator built a binary nested coordination instead of a flat list of conjuncts
3.convention: Coordinated clauses at the same level are annotated as a single flat 'and' with op1..opN

3.kind: Event 事件 / 空袭 coded as 事件 with mod 空袭 (no event) rather than 事件 identity-91 空袭-01; 发生 uses ARG1 instead of ARG0; coreference chain wrong
3.cause: Annotator treated 空袭 as a plain modifier noun instead of an event with identity-91, losing the event node, its modal, and its coreference link; the 事件 in 发生 clause was a separate node rather than the same one
3.convention: Event nouns (空袭) equated with a generic 事件 head use identity-91 to an event concept, and the same 事件 is reused across the clauses

3.kind: 世界各国领袖: annotator made 各国 a concept with possessor and 世界 as mod; gold uses 国 with 各 mod and part-of 世界, via possessor-of
3.cause: Annotator did not split 各 (every) from 国 and used possessor/mod instead of part-of and possessor-of
3.convention: 各国 is segmented into 国 with mod 各; the 'world' is expressed with part-of; the leader is linked via possessor-of

3.kind: Aspect errors: 作为-01 given performance, gold state; 饶恕 and others OK; extra aspects on non-events
3.cause: Annotator judged 将粮食作为战争武器 as an event in progress, while gold treats it as a state-like characterization

3.kind: Temporal relations wrong: 发生 before 宣布/表示 instead of after; 宣布 overlap 暂停 instead of after; 发生 overlap 袭击/作为 where gold has 指出 overlap them
3.cause: Annotator reversed the direction of 后 ('after the incident' means the incident precedes, i.e., the 后 clause is :after the main events in gold's encoding) and treated announcement and suspension as simultaneous; also anchored the content-clause events to 发生 rather than 指出
3.convention: Events inside a reported speech clause are temporally linked to the reporting verb; an announcement of a suspension is after the suspension

3.kind: Spurious ARG0 on 暂停/行动 and ARG1 on 震惊 etc. and extra 人 argument edits
3.cause: Annotator added arguments not present in gold (e.g., ARG0 s3w for 行动)

4.cause: Annotator used a PropBank-style/English-lexicon relation concept for 但/虽然 instead of the UMR contrast-01 concept for concessive/adversative coordination.
4.convention: Adversative/concessive coordination (虽然...但, but, however) is annotated with contrast-01 taking ARG1 and ARG2.

4.kind: 以方 ('the Israeli side') analyzed as a separate entity 方 with possessor-of instead of reusing the country
4.cause: Annotator decomposed 以方 into a noun 方 possessed by the country rather than treating it as an anaphoric reference to the country. The gold reuses the country node (s4c2) as ARG0 of 坚持 and 以为. The gold's have-org-role-92 concept is the unmatched one in the evaluator output, so the modal edges attached to it were counted as wrong. Modal relations for the agent therefore attach to the wrong node.
4.convention: Referring expressions for a previously mentioned entity (e.g. 以方 'the Israeli side') are annotated as re-entrant references to the same entity node, not as new nodes.

4.kind: 空袭 annotated as a bare noun, not an event concept 空袭-01, with no aspect
4.cause: Annotator treated 空袭 as a plain noun, but the gold treats event nouns as events with a sense and aspect. As a result the gold's modal edge author :full-affirmative 空袭-01 and the aspect performance are missing.
4.convention: Event nominals (空袭 'airstrike') are annotated as event concepts with a sense (-01) and an aspect, and receive modal annotation.

4.kind: Hamas membership analyzed as armed-organization with part-of, instead of have-org-role-92 with ARG2 organization
4.cause: Annotator used part-of with an armed-organization concept rather than the UMR have-org-role-92 pattern, where the member is ARG1 of the have-org-role-92 and the organization is its ARG2.
4.convention: Membership in an organization is annotated with have-org-role-92 (ARG1 = member, ARG2 = organization), and the organization is typed organization.

4.kind: 武装 as a passive predicate (ARG1-of 武装-01) with state aspect, instead of mod 武装-01 with performance aspect
4.cause: Annotator built a relative-clause-style modification of 成员 using ARG1-of, while the gold makes 武装 a modifier (:mod) of 成员 with performance aspect. The annotator also gave it state aspect.
4.convention: Attributive modifiers that are event words are attached with :mod, and aspect is assigned to those eventive modifiers as well.

4.kind: Argument structure of 混入: 成员 should be ARG0 and 车队 ARG1, but the annotator used ARG1 成员 and place 车队
4.cause: Annotator treated 车队 as a locative (车队中) and 成员 as the theme, while the gold treats 成员 as the one who mixes in (ARG0) and 车队 as the thing mixed into (ARG1).
4.convention: Follow the PropBank roleset for the verb: the location-like complement of 混入 is a core ARG1, not a :place.

4.cause: Annotator used the generic :mod for the adverb 立刻 ('immediately'), where UMR uses :temporal for time adverbs.
4.convention: Temporal adverbs ('immediately', 'then', 'already') are annotated with :temporal, not :mod.

4.kind: Aspect errors: 坚持 / identity-91 state vs. performance, and missing aspect on 空袭 and 武装
4.cause: Annotator placed the aspect on the wrong nodes: it put aspect state on 坚持 but not on identity-91 (gold has state on both), put performance on 导致 and 混入 correctly, but mis-assigned 武装 as state (gold: performance) and left 空袭 without aspect.
4.convention: Each eventive node, including identity-91 and eventive nominals and modifiers, gets an aspect value.

4.kind: Temporal structure of the reported event chain: wrong relations among 坚持, 以为, 导致, 混入, 空袭, and 道歉
4.cause: Annotator used overlap chaining of 坚持, 导致 and 以为, with 以为 before 混入 on the wrong side. The gold places 坚持 before 以为, 以为 after 导致, 以为 before 混入, and 导致 overlapping 空袭. The annotator also linked 道歉 to 坚持 via DCT-before, whereas the gold has 道歉 overlap 坚持.
4.convention: Temporal relations of events in an embedded reported/cause clause are anchored to the matrix event, and the verb of belief precedes the believed event. Coordinated events in sequence are linked with overlap to the next event.

4.kind: Modal annotation: 混入 marked full-negative under 以为, and missing author-level modal edges
4.cause: Annotator treated the mistaken belief as counterfactual, marking 混入 full-negative, whereas the gold marks it full-affirmative under 以为 (the belief content is what the holder asserted). The annotator also omitted author :full-affirmative on the country and on 空袭, and linked the full-affirmative edges to s4f rather than the country.
4.convention: The content of a belief/attitude predicate is annotated from the holder's perspective (holder :full-affirmative content), and entities and event nominals are assigned author-level modal edges.

4.kind: Coreference: annotated links to s1f and s1r instead of the gold's s3 and s2 antecedents
4.cause: Annotator linked 空袭 to the sentence-1 event, and 车队 to a sentence-1 entity, rather than the most recent antecedents. The chains end up partial and missing members (e.g. snt15, snt19 country mentions, and 事件/袭击 mentions).
4.convention: Coreference links the mention to its antecedent, and chains must cover all mentions of the same entity or event across the document. Country mentions, including 以方, join the country chain.

5.kind: Named event name truncated and typed as 行动-01 predicate instead of event with full name
5.cause: The annotator treated 行动 as a verb concept (行动-01) with the name only 阿克萨 洪水. Gold treats 阿克萨洪水行动 as one named event, with 行动 as the last name token. The extra predicate also led to extra temporal (发动 overlap 行动) and modal relations.
5.convention: A named event keeps its whole name, including the generic final noun (行动, 战争), as name tokens under an event/war concept. It is not annotated as a separate predicate.

5.kind: Named war annotated as 战争-01 with an and-conjunction of the parties instead of a named war entity
5.cause: The annotator decomposed 以色列—哈马斯战争 into a predicate with a conjoined ARG0. Gold treats the whole expression as a named entity (war) with name tokens 以色列 — 哈马斯 战争. This broke the 爆发 ARG1 and created extra temporal and modal relations on the war node.
5.convention: A proper-name event such as 'X—Y war' is one named entity (war with :name), not a predicate with participants. The name includes all its tokens.

5.kind: Spurious 方面 entity with possessor wrapping the country
5.cause: The annotator reified 以色列方面 ('the Israeli side') as a separate concept with possessor-of. Gold uses the country directly as the agent.
5.convention: Light nouns for a party or side (方面, 'side') are not given their own node. The country or organization is used directly as the argument.

5.kind: Extra ARG1 on 反击-01 (reference to the 行动 node)
5.cause: The annotator added an ARG1 for the implicit target of 反击, linking it to the attack event. Gold gives 反击 only an ARG0.
5.convention: Do not add arguments that are only implicit or inferred. Annotate only arguments expressed in the sentence.

5.kind: Wrong temporal relation between 宣战 and 爆发, and between 发动 and 反击
5.cause: The annotator ordered events by narrative sequence: 宣战 before 爆发, and 发动 before 反击. Gold has 宣战 overlap 爆发 and 发动 after 反击, reading 反击 and 宣战 as co-occurring with the outbreak. Gold's 发动 :after 反击 is odd given 随即 ('immediately after'), so it may be a gold error.
5.convention: Events joined by 并 or in a close consecutive chain are often annotated as :overlap. Use :before only when the text clearly marks strict precedence.

5.kind: Missing cross-sentence coreference chain links for the country (以色列) and the 此 reference
5.cause: The annotator linked s5c only to the previous sentence mention and did not extend the chain through later sentences (s15, s19). It also missed the 此 («此后») anaphor in snt6.
5.convention: Link every re-mention of the same entity to the chain, including later mentions and anaphoric demonstratives.

6.kind: Causal construction analyzed with have-reason-91 as root instead of 面临-01 with :cause; the 缘故 noun and include-91 were not used
6.cause: The annotator treated 由于...缘故 as a clausal causal connective and promoted have-reason-91 to the root with ARG1/ARG2. The gold keeps the main event 面临 as root, attaches the reason via :cause to the noun 缘故, and expresses '封锁 etc.' as include-91 (ARG2-of) with 封锁 as ARG1. The annotator also mapped 等 ('etc.') to a separate :mod concept instead of the include-91 construction.
6.convention: A cause phrase headed by a noun like 缘故 is annotated as :cause on the main event pointing to that noun. A list-ending 等 ('etc.') is expressed with include-91 rather than a :mod concept. Do not restructure the sentence with have-reason-91 as root when the cause is an explicit noun phrase.

6.kind: Wrong named-entity type for 加沙地带 (country-region instead of local-region)
6.cause: The annotator chose country-region for Gaza Strip, though it is a sub-national territory; the gold uses local-region and the coref chain depends on it.
6.convention: Territories or areas within or between states, such as strips, districts and zones, are typed local-region, not country-region.

6.kind: Demonstrative 此 in 此后 not annotated as an :op1 of 后
6.cause: The annotator treated 后 as a bare temporal noun and ignored the anaphoric demonstrative 此 'this', which the gold represents as a child concept of 后.
6.convention: A demonstrative inside a temporal expression such as 此后 is annotated as :op1 of the temporal noun, and it is the anchor of the temporal and coreference relations.

6.kind: Temporal relations wrong: 此后 not placed after DCT or related to events
6.cause: The annotator used a flat overlap with the document-creation-time and chained the two events, rather than anchoring the 此后 time expression (before DCT) and relating it to 面临 (after) and to 封锁 (overlap). This follows from the missing 此 node and from the different graph structure.
6.convention: A temporal expression like 此后 gets its own node, annotated as before the document-creation-time. The main event is :after that node, and the embedded event is :overlap with it.

6.kind: Missing same-event coreference to the earlier 爆发 event via 此
6.cause: Since 此 was not annotated, the annotator did not link the anaphoric 此后 to the earlier event (s5 爆发).
6.convention: An anaphoric demonstrative referring back to an earlier event is linked with :same-event to that event.

6.kind: Incomplete entity coreference chains for the country and the region
6.cause: The annotator linked 以色列 to s4c, but not to the s5 country. The Gaza chain was linked only to s1g and missed the gold chain (s3l and others). Chains were not tracked consistently across the document.
6.convention: Every repeated mention of the same entity, including those in neighboring sentences, is linked into the same coreference chain.

6.kind: Modal annotation only partially matches: the annotator's event nodes differ, and the gold duplicates the root modal
6.cause: The annotator's modal relations attach to its own graph (面临 and 封锁), which is consistent with the gold except for the structure. The duplicate (root :modal author) in the gold is likely an artifact.

7.kind: Adverb 已 not annotated as :mod; 'gold' has it as mod of the event
7.cause: Annotator omitted the aspectual adverb 已 ('already') and gave no :mod for it. The country-region concept from 加沙 was matched against 已 in the evaluator alignment.
7.convention: Aspectual/degree adverbs such as 已 are kept as a :mod child of the event they modify.

7.kind: Wrong sense/role for 身亡 and wrong core argument label (ARG1 instead of ARG0, no -01 suffix)
7.cause: Annotator used the unlisted lemma 身亡-00 and treated the dying person as ARG1 (patient) instead of the ARG0 in the frame used by the gold.
7.convention: Use the PropBank frame (-01) for the predicate and the roleset's labels for the core arguments; if the frame is found, use its numbering.

7.kind: Organization attached as :part-of of the person instead of as :place of the 工作-01 event
7.cause: Annotator inferred a membership relation (:part-of) between staff and UNRWA rather than a workplace location relation under 工作-01.
7.convention: The organization that people work for/at is attached as :place of the 工作 event, not as :part-of the person.

7.kind: Gaza typed as country-region and annotated with :mod, instead of local-region with :place
7.cause: Annotator chose the wrong named-entity type (country-region instead of local-region for Gaza) and attached it as :mod of 平民 instead of :place. The name tokens were also mismatched, because the type differs.
7.convention: Gaza (a sub-national region) is a local-region; a location attached to a nominal is :place.

7.kind: Aspect errors: 工作-01 given activity and 提供-01/援助-01 given habitual, where gold has the reverse
7.cause: Annotator swapped aspect: marked the staff's working as activity, the organization's providing aid as habitual, and added aspect to 援助. Gold has 工作 habitual, 提供 activity, and no aspect on the nominal 援助.
7.convention: Ongoing aid provision as a current activity gets activity; a staff member's work role gets habitual; event nouns used as arguments (援助) get no aspect.

7.kind: Temporal structure wrong: 至 date treated as an event with :contained; gold chains document-creation-time :before date, date :before events, and event overlaps
7.cause: Annotator set DCT :before the death, then put the date as containing the death and the activity overlapping it. It used DCT :overlap for 提供/工作/简称, rather than relating them to the date-entity. It also failed to relate DCT to the date itself.
7.convention: A 至 date-entity is anchored to document-creation-time with :before. Events in the sentence are ordered relative to that date, and background events chain with :overlap.

7.kind: Modal annotation extra for 援助-01
7.cause: Annotator gave a modal relation to the nominal event 援助, which gold does not annotate. It was a consequence of treating it as an event.
7.convention: Event nouns that serve as arguments (not asserted events) get no modal annotation.

7.kind: Coreference for Gaza missing or wrong chain
7.cause: Annotator linked s7g to s1g (country-region), but the gold chain is the local-region chain starting at sentence 6 and continuing. The mismatched entity type and anchor caused the chain to be missed.
7.convention: Repeated mentions of the same named place are linked in one same-entity chain, using the correct entity type.

8.kind: Judges represented as extra 人 entity with ARG1-of have-org-role-92 instead of 法官 as the head with ARG3-of
8.cause: Annotator introduced a generic 人 head and put 法官 as the ARG3 of have-org-role-92, rather than making the role noun 法官 the head concept and attaching have-org-role-92 via ARG3-of. This also shifted all ARG0 relations (通过, 审理, 要求) onto the extra 人 node.
8.convention: A person identified by a role/title is annotated with the role noun as the head concept, with have-org-role-92 attached via :ARG3-of (no generic 'person' node).

8.kind: Extra :ARG0 on 审理-01 (reentrant to the judge) that gold does not have
8.cause: Annotator added an ARG0 reentrancy on 审理 inside the 参与 clause; gold leaves 审理 with only the ARG1.
8.convention: Do not add arguments that are not overtly expressed or already supplied by the embedding construction.

8.kind: 种族灭绝 treated as a single noun concept instead of decomposed event 灭绝-01 with ARG1 种族
8.cause: Annotator kept the compound as one lexical unit and so did not create the event 灭绝-01 or its ARG1 种族. This also lost the associated temporal (犯下 overlap 灭绝) and modal (诉 unspecified 灭绝) relations.
8.convention: Verbal compounds with an event-denoting head are split into the event predicate and its argument (e.g. 灭绝-01 with :ARG1 种族).

8.kind: Temporal-quantity (3天前) attached as :temporal inside 通过-01 rather than at the top level of the sentence, with wrong relations to 参与 and 通过 in the document-level graph
8.cause: Annotator attached the time expression to the 通过 clause only, whereas gold attaches it to the whole coordination (and). In the document-level graph, the annotator related the time quantity itself to events (before/overlap) rather than 通过 :contained in the temporal-quantity. The annotator also gave author :full-affirmative to 事发 without gold's pattern for 前, and missed author :full-affirmative on 前.
8.convention: A sentence-initial time adjunct scoping over the whole sentence attaches as :temporal to the top node. The event is :contained in the temporal-quantity. The 前 node (not the 事发 event) receives the full-affirmative modal.

8.kind: Internal temporal relations among 审理, 诉 and 犯下 wrong

14.kind: Wrong modal/aspect on the main clause and misplaced structure

15.kind: Sequence of clauses not structured as consecutive; wrong top-level concept and structure (and/后 wrapper instead of consecutive with event ops)
15.cause: Annotator treated 后 'after' as a temporal-relation concept heading the clause and made the hit event the root with 'and'. The gold represents the narrative chain of events as a consecutive with each clause as an op, and expresses ordering through temporal relations.
15.convention: Sequences of successive events in a narrative are coordinated with a consecutive concept whose ops are the events. Temporal connectives like 后 are not made concepts; the order is encoded in the document-level temporal relations.

15.kind: Adverb 首先 'first' omitted; 后 wrongly introduced as a temporal node
15.cause: Annotator reified the connective 后 as a :temporal node and skipped the adverb 首先, which the gold attaches as :temporal to the hit event.
15.convention: Temporal adverbs (首先) are annotated as :temporal children of the event they modify; clause-linking 后 is not a concept.

15.kind: Compound modifier 精确制导 not split into 制导 with mod 精确; 无人机 treated as possessor instead of mod
15.cause: Annotator kept 精确制导 as one lexical concept and made 无人机 a possessor of the missile with a nested 军队. The gold decomposes the compound and analyzes 无人机 as a :mod of 导弹, with 军队 as :possessor-of of the missile.
15.convention: Compound modifiers are decomposed into head with mod. Noun modifiers of a noun that describe its type (drone missile) are :mod, not :possessor.

15.kind: Possessor structure of 军队 reversed/misplaced (nested under drone rather than directly attached to missile)
15.cause: Because 无人机 was made the missile's possessor, 军队 got nested under it with :possessor-of, so it does not attach to the missile as in the gold.

15.kind: Ordinal's measure word 辆 attached to the entity (:unit) rather than inside the ordinal-entity
15.cause: Annotator put :unit on the noun 汽车/车 instead of on the ordinal-entity node, which the gold does.
15.convention: The classifier/measure word in an ordinal phrase is the :unit of the ordinal-entity.

15.kind: Missing :part-of linking vehicles to the convoy 车队
15.cause: Annotator did not infer the implicit part-whole relation of the first/second vehicle to the convoy.
15.convention: Implicit part-whole relations between vehicles and the convoy they belong to are annotated with :part-of.

15.kind: Survivor participant role: 人员 is ARG1 of 移动 in annotation but ARG0 in gold
15.cause: Annotator treated the moving personnel as a theme (ARG1), whereas the gold treats them as the agent-like mover (ARG0).

15.kind: 逃跑 'escape' not annotated as purpose of 移动; coordinated instead with its own ARG0
15.cause: Annotator coordinated 移动, 逃跑 and 呼救 in a flat and; the gold subordinates 逃跑 as :purpose of 移动 (with implicit subject) and coordinates only 移动 and 呼救.
15.convention: Verbs in a serial construction expressing aim (到…上逃跑) are annotated as :purpose of the main event.

15.kind: Temporal relations wrong: 卸下/离开 coordinated events given overlap vs gold after; direction/orientation of before/after chain differs
15.cause: Annotator ordered the events by narrative time (卸下 overlap 离开, both before 命中). Gold, following the 后 clause, encodes the opposite orientation: 离开 after 命中 and a different chain between 命中 and 存活/移动/逃跑. The annotator also placed 逃跑 as overlap with 移动 instead of the gold's purpose-based after relation and linked 存活 differently.

15.kind: Previous-sentence event temporal link: 前往 vs 卸下 given :before rather than :after
15.cause: The annotator placed the earlier 前往 before 卸下, which is the natural order; the gold's :after direction here is inverted relative to its own chain, likely an annotation inconsistency.

15.kind: Coreference: spurious country chain and missed vehicle chains
15.cause: Annotator linked the country node to earlier mentions of countries (extra chain) and its coref chains for the vehicles (汽车/车 in later sentences) and the 击毁/空袭 event chain were missing or incomplete; it also linked 军队 to a different antecedent than the gold.

16.kind: Wrong aspect on 行驶-01 (activity instead of endeavor)
16.cause: Annotator treated a bounded-duration motion verb as an unbounded activity; the gold uses endeavor for a durative, atelic process with no inherent endpoint.
16.convention: Use the aspect value endeavor for dynamic, durative, atelic events performed by an agent (e.g., movement or travel verbs), rather than activity.

16.kind: Classifier 辆 attached as :unit of the noun instead of inside the ordinal-entity
16.cause: Annotator put the classifier as :unit on the head noun (车/汽车) rather than under the ordinal-entity node with the ordinal value, so the ordinal-entity lacks the unit and the classifier node is unmatched.

16.kind: Wrong temporal relation for 行驶 vs 命中: before instead of contained; missing relation to previous sentence
16.cause: Annotator took 'X后 Y' as simple precedence and also added a sentence-15 命中 before 命中 relation. Gold marks the 行驶 event as contained in the 命中 event's time and links 行驶 to the earlier 逃跑 by overlap.

16.kind: Wrong temporal relation between 行驶 and 击毁 (annotator: s15 命中 overlap 击毁; gold: 行驶 before 击毁)
16.cause: Annotator linked the earlier 命中 event directly to the 击毁 in the relative clause with overlap, whereas gold orders the 行驶 event before the earlier 击毁, which is a coreferent of the earlier hit.

16.kind: Extra temporal relation 命中 overlap 离 (state in the same sentence)
16.cause: Annotator added an overlap between the main event and the distance state in the second conjunct, which the gold does not annotate.
16.convention: Do not annotate a temporal relation for a stative measurement/location predicate (离 distance) with the co-ordinated event in the same sentence.

16.kind: Missing entity coreference for 车 and 汽车 across sentences; event coreference chain wrong
16.cause: Annotator only annotated an event coreference (s15h same-event s16k) and no same-entity links for the vehicles (第二辆车 with earlier 车; 第一辆汽车 with earlier 汽车), so the entity chains are missing; the event chain also gets merged wrongly with later events.

17.kind: Wrong conjunction concept: 'but-91' instead of contrast-91
17.cause: Annotator used the surface word 'but' as a concept name rather than the UMR relation contrast-91

17.kind: Wrong structure for the second clause: 'and' coordinating 移动 and 继续, with the 遭到 clause as ARG2 of the contrast. Gold uses 'consecutive' joining 遭到 and 身亡, while 继续 is a purpose of 移动
17.cause: Annotator treated 继续逃命 as a coordinated event with 移动 and did not recognize the later clause (遭到 ... 全员身亡) as a consecutive sequence. It attached 身亡 as a cause-of the attack instead of a second consecutive conjunct

17.kind: 继续 aspect state instead of activity
17.cause: Annotator treated 继续 (continue) as a state rather than an ongoing activity
17.convention: Aspectual verbs like 继续 'continue' take aspect activity

17.kind: Wrong participant roles: 幸存者 annotated as ARG1 of 移动 and ARG1 of 袭击, and 工作者 as ARG1 of 身亡, where gold uses ARG0 for those (gold ARG0 for 移动-01 and 身亡-01)
17.cause: Annotator treated the movers and the dying people as patients/themes (unaccusative reading) while the Chinese frames assign ARG0
17.convention: Follow the PropBank frame roles: the 移动-01 mover and 身亡-01 dier are ARG0 in the Chinese frames

17.kind: Wrong sense numbers and roles for 驶离 and 身亡: annotator used -00 (unknown) instead of -01, and put the place as ARG1 rather than ARG2 and the departer as ARG0
17.cause: Annotator did not find or use the PropBank frames and gave placeholder -00 senses; it also guessed role labels
17.convention: Use the PropBank frame -01 when it exists; the departed-from location is ARG2 for 驶离-01

17.kind: Ordinal unit placement: the classifier (辆, 次) should be under the ordinal-entity's :unit, but annotator put 辆 as :unit of the noun and omitted 次 for 第三次
17.cause: Annotator attached the classifier to the head noun rather than to the ordinal-entity, and dropped the 次 classifier/measure
17.convention: For ordinals with classifiers (第三辆, 第三次), the classifier is the :unit of the ordinal-entity

17.kind: Ordinal on 袭击 attached to the wrong node in alignment and extra cause relation; annotator added :ARG1 to the attack and :cause-of linking attack to 身亡, and 遭到 ARG0 as the survivors instead of the car
17.cause: Annotator over-interpreted the discourse (causal link between attack and deaths) and treated 遭到 as having the survivors as ARG0, whereas the gold has the vehicle (汽车) as ARG0 and no explicit ARG1 on 袭击
17.convention: Do not add :cause-of for implicit discourse causality; relation between consecutive events is conveyed by consecutive

17.kind: Temporal relations wrong or missing in the sequence 移动 / 驶离 / 遭到 / 袭击 / 身亡 / 逃命: wrong direction for 命中 vs 移动, 遭到 vs 袭击, missing 驶离 after 遭到, 袭击 vs 身亡 etc.
17.cause: Annotator computed the order from the surface order rather than the real chronology (驶离 precedes the attack; 后 means after), and used overlap/contained inconsistently with the structure
17.convention: For '在 X 后 ...' the main event is after X; consecutive events are ordered by :after; events attached by purpose (继续逃命) overlap the main motion event

17.kind: Spurious temporal relation 移动 :overlap 继续, and 继续 :overlap 逃命 where gold has 移动 :overlap 逃命
17.cause: Annotator made 继续 a coordinated event and thus gave it its own temporal relations

17.kind: Coreference errors: wrongly links 命中 with 袭击 in sentence 17 (s16h same-event s17y) and misses the chains of 车 across sentences and the 身亡 chain (身亡 with sentences 2 and 24) and the attack chain across later sentences
17.cause: Annotator over-linked the earlier hit event to the 袭击 in the place-of clause and did not link later mentions of 车 and the death events
17.convention: Link repeated mentions of the same vehicle/event across sentences into one chain; the earlier attack event and the place of attack need not be identified with a different event

18.kind: Quantifier 每一辆 split into 每 + unit 辆 and attached as quant/unit of 车 instead of a single mod concept 每一辆
18.cause: Annotator decomposed the measure-word phrase 每一辆 into a quantifier 每 with a separate 辆 unit, rather than treating it as one concept attached by :mod. This also misaligned the 车 nodes for ARG1 comparison.
18.convention: Distributive quantifier plus classifier phrases such as 每一辆 are a single concept attached with :mod. Classifiers are not annotated as :unit unless they are part of a quantity or ordinal entity.

18.kind: Classifier 辆 attached as :unit of 车 in the ordinal phrase instead of inside the ordinal-entity
18.cause: Annotator put :unit on the noun 车, but the gold places the classifier 辆 under the ordinal-entity (第二辆).

18.cause: Annotator interpreted 其中 as a partitive and added include-91 with ARG2 pointing to the earlier 车. Gold simply leaves 其中 out and uses a plain 车 with an ordinal.

18.kind: 过程中 temporal: 中 should be the head with 过程 as its :op1, but annotator used 过程 directly
18.cause: Annotator dropped the locative/temporal postposition 中 and used 过程 as the temporal node, while the gold keeps 中 as a concept with :op1 过程.
18.convention: Postpositions such as 中 forming temporal or locative phrases are kept as concepts that take the noun as :op1.

18.cause: Annotator treated the degree adverb 更 as a generic modifier.
18.convention: Degree adverbs modifying a predicate (更, 很, 非常) take :degree.

18.kind: Distance noun linked to 逃离 with :topic instead of :extent-of
18.cause: Annotator chose :topic for the relation between 距离 and the modifying clause 逃离追杀的, while the gold uses the inverse :extent-of.

18.kind: Wrong aspect for 逃离-01 (process instead of performance)
18.cause: Annotator treated the ongoing flight as an unbounded process, but the gold takes it as a bounded performance.

18.kind: Temporal chain wrong: missing DCT :before for 逃离, and relations anchored to the wrong events
18.cause: Annotator linked 逃离 to the previous sentence's event (s17e) instead of anchoring it before document-creation-time. It added an extra 逃离 overlap 长达. It also overlapped 逃离 with 命中 instead of chaining 追杀 with 命中.
18.convention: Past-narrated events are anchored with :before to document-creation-time. Subsequent events are chained in order, and stative/measure predicates such as 长达 are not given a temporal relation.

18.kind: Missing coreference links (same-event 命中 and same-entity 车 across sentences)
18.cause: Annotator gave no coref relations for this sentence. It did not link the repeated 命中 or the 车 mentions to the earlier ones.
18.convention: Repeated mentions of the same event or entity across sentences are linked with :same-event / :same-entity.

19.kind: Source attribution (根据…说法) modeled as root have-source-91 over the whole sentence instead of identity-91 on 情报 plus 说法 with have-source-91
19.cause: Annotator treated 根据以军的说法 as a sentence-level source frame and made have-source-91 the root. It dropped the 说法 concept and the identity-91 linking 说法 to the intelligence. The gold keeps the 得到 clause as the top-level event and attaches the source to 说法 (ARG2 = 军队).
19.convention: A 根据X的说法 phrase is annotated as the noun 说法 with have-source-91 (ARG2 = source), linked to the content by identity-91. It is not a root-level have-source-91 wrapper.

19.kind: Wrong top-level discourse structure: the annotator nests but-91 and contrast-91 differently from gold
19.cause: The annotator put 得到, 停留 and 离开 under and/contrast-91 and wrapped everything in but-91 with ARG1 = and, ARG2 = 下达. The gold uses contrast-91 (op1 = 得到 clause, op2 = but-91 of 离开 and 下达). Gold has 停留 inside the 发现 content. The 而…则 contrast (停留 vs 离开) and the 但 (but) clause were mis-scoped.
19.convention: Conjunction and contrast concepts use op1/op2 for coordinated clauses. Content clauses of a report (情报称…) include the whole reported event sequence, and 但 connects the preceding clause with the final event.

19.kind: Content of 情报 modeled as :topic of 发现-01 instead of identity-91 with the 发现 event, and the 混 and 停留 events are not coordinated under 发现
19.cause: The annotator used a topic relation for a clausal complement noun (情报称…) rather than the identity-91 pattern. It attached 混 directly under 发现 and moved 停留 outside.
19.convention: A noun with a content clause (情报称…) is linked to the content event by identity-91 (ARG2 = the event). Coordinated events in the content are grouped under and.

19.kind: Missing 当时 (temporal) and 该 (mod) as separate nodes
19.cause: The annotator ignored 当时 and the demonstrative 该 and did not give them concepts.
19.convention: Temporal words such as 当时 are annotated as :temporal; demonstratives such as 该 are annotated as :mod concepts.

19.kind: Wrong sense for 混 (混-01 vs 混-03) and wrong argument role for the mixing person (ARG1 on 混 vs gold ARG0)
19.cause: The annotator picked the wrong PropBank roleset and attached the person with ARG1. Gold uses 混-03 with the person as ARG0.
19.convention: Choose the PropBank roleset that matches the usage, and use that roleset's role numbering for core arguments.

19.kind: 武装 modeled as a predicate with ARG1-of, aspect state, instead of a :mod 武装-01 with aspect performance
19.cause: The annotator treated the modifier as a stative relative-clause predicate of the person. Gold uses mod with performance aspect.
19.convention: Attributive verbal modifiers of a noun are attached with :mod, not as an ARG1-of predicate.

19.kind: Missing 按照-01 and 获得-01 structure for the route (按照…路线, 获得批准); the annotator used 路线 with :manner and 批准-01 with ARG0 = army
19.cause: The annotator simplified 按照 to a plain :manner noun and 事先获得以军批准 to 批准-01 with the army as ARG0. Gold has 按照-01 as manner, the route as ARG0 of 获得-01 (ARG2 = army) with 批准 as its ARG1, and 事先 temporal on 获得.
19.convention: Light and support verbs such as 按照 and 获得 are kept as their own event concepts. The temporal adverb attaches to the event it modifies (获得).

19.kind: Route/safety arguments: 安全-01 ARG1 vs gold ARG0 for 路线; 行驶 as :mod vs gold :path-of; ARG1 vs ARG0 mismatch
19.cause: The annotator used ARG1 for the safe thing and :mod 行驶-01 for the travel route. Gold uses ARG0 for the route and :path-of for the driving event. This also affects the purpose clause 交通路线安全.
19.convention: For 安全-01 the route is ARG0 in this annotation scheme. A route modified by a travel event uses :path-of.

19.kind: Wrong possessor relation on 车队 for the organization (:possessor vs :possessor-of)
19.cause: The annotator wrote :possessor from 车队 to the organization. Gold uses :possessor-of on the organization node pointing at the fleet (gold: 车队 :possessor-of international-organization).
19.convention: Follow the gold's direction for the possessive relation between a named organization and the thing it owns.

19.kind: 命令 and 攻击: annotator made 命令-01 a verb with ARG1 攻击-01 (aspect process); gold uses noun 命令 with :mod 攻击-01 (performance)
19.cause: The annotator verbalized the noun 命令 with a -01 sense and made 攻击 its argument. Gold keeps 命令 as a plain noun modified by 攻击-01.
19.convention: A noun-noun compound of an event-noun modifier and a head noun uses :mod, and the noun head is not given a PropBank sense when it has no frame.

19.kind: 无人机操作员 analyzed as 操作员 with ARG0-of 操作-01 (activity) instead of 操作员 with :mod 无人机
19.cause: The annotator decomposed the agentive noun into an event and its patient. Gold treats it as a simple compound noun with :mod.
19.convention: Compound nouns with an agentive head (e.g. 操作员) are annotated as noun + :mod and are not decomposed into an event.

19.kind: Aspect errors on several events (e.g. 武装, 确保/安全, 攻击, 批准) and an extra activity
19.cause: The annotator assigned state/process/activity aspects where the gold uses performance, notably the 确保 and 攻击 events, and state on 混 and 持有 as in gold but different elsewhere.

19.cause: The annotator chose a linear chain of overlaps that follows its different graph structure, so the reporting event and the events it contains were ordered differently. It also linked 负责, 确保, 行驶 to 离开 or 下达 inconsistently with gold.

19.kind: Extra coreference chain membership (country 以色列 linked to earlier mentions) and different antecedent links (车队, 货车, 仓库, 军队)
19.cause: The annotator linked the country node to earlier sentences' mentions (s4c), which gold does not do in this form, and chose different antecedents for 车队, the org, the army, the truck and the warehouse.

20.kind: Compound proper-like term 去冲突地带 split into 地带 with mod 去冲突, and the deconflicted-zone English name omitted
20.cause: The annotator analysed the Chinese compound compositionally. It did not treat the quoted term as one concept with an identity-91 link to the English gloss 'deconflicted zone' given in the parentheses.

20.kind: Place relation attached to the wrong head. The annotator put place on 袭击-01 instead of on 发动-01.

21.kind: Coordinate list analyzed as identity-91 clauses with 坐标 named entities instead of include-91 of event 空袭-01 with ordinal and place coordinates
21.check: a_event_found, a_event_concept, a_entity_found, f_name_tokens, c_other_attributes, d_peripheral_event, d_core_args_abstract
21.cause: The annotator treated the bracketed 坐标 1/2/3 labels and the copula 是 literally, building identity-91 predications between a 坐标 name and a coordinate value. It did not see the sentence as enumerating the individual airstrikes as members of the 这次空袭 set, with the 第二次/第三次 clauses elided.
21.convention: A 是 clause giving the location of an ordinal event is annotated as the event itself (or an implicit-predicate when elided) with :ord and :place. Parts of a whole are linked with include-91 (ARG2-of on the whole, ARG1 an and of the members). Bracketed reference labels are not named entities.

21.kind: Coordinates are not represented as geographical-coordinate-entity with :lat/:long values
21.cause: The annotator modeled 北纬 and 东经 as separate entities with :quant and a 度 :unit instead of using the dedicated coordinate entity type.
21.convention: Latitude/longitude pairs are annotated as geographical-coordinate-entity with :lat and :long numeric values, with no unit nodes.

21.kind: Compound 调查报导 organization modifier annotated as a single concept instead of a conjunction of two events 调查-01 and 报导-01
21.check: a_event_found, a_event_concept, a_entity_found, d_peripheral_entity, h_temporal, i_modal
21.cause: The annotator treated 调查报导 as an unanalyzed noun modifier. The gold decomposes it into the verbal events 调查 and 报导, which are conjoined and carry aspect process, with their own temporal and modal relations.
21.convention: Nominal compounds built from eventive words are decomposed into events with their senses, joined by and when coordinated, with aspect, and with document-level relations of their own.

21.kind: 空袭 annotated as a bare noun concept without the -01 sense
21.cause: The annotator treated 空袭 as a plain noun in the 这次空袭 and 以色列的精准空袭 phrases instead of as an event concept with the -01 sense.
21.convention: Eventive nouns such as 空袭 are annotated as event concepts with -01 and carry aspect.

21.kind: Israel's airstrike annotated with :ARG0 country and :possessor mapped inconsistently, :mod for the manner word, and habitual aspect
21.cause: The annotator moved the country into an ARG0 role, so the possessor in 的特征 became the airstrike's ARG0 rather than a possessor. It labeled 精准 as :mod where gold uses :manner (the unit shows the reverse for the evaluator's labels, so the label choice is inconsistent), and it assigned habitual aspect to a characterizing airstrike where gold uses process.
21.convention: A possessive 的 phrase on an eventive noun uses :possessor, not :ARG0. A modifier describing how the event is carried out is :manner. An event used as a descriptive feature is given aspect process.

21.kind: Wrong aspect assignments and extra state aspect
21.cause: Because the coordinate clauses were annotated as identity-91 states, the annotator assigned state, and the airstrike events (这次空袭 and the ordinal airstrikes) were left without performance aspect.
21.convention: Event mentions of airstrikes are given aspect performance. 是 clauses that give event locations do not produce state.

21.kind: Wrong temporal relations within the sentence
21.cause: The annotator ordered 分析 before 报导 as overlapping and tied 报导 to 具有, while gold places 分析 after 报导 and 空袭 as the anchor of 具有. It also anchored the airstrikes and identity nodes to document-creation-time and omitted the relations of 分析 before 空袭 and of 空袭 overlapping its member airstrikes and 以色列的空袭.
21.convention: The reported event's temporal relations attach to the event argument (空袭) that 具有 predicates over. Member events overlap the whole, and the nested possessor airstrike overlaps it.

21.kind: Modal relations missing for airstrike events, and the annotation attaches modal wrongly
21.cause: The annotator attached full-affirmative to the 具有 and 空袭-01 events through the organization, omitted the author's modal edges for the airstrike events, and added modal edges for identity-91 nodes that should not exist.
21.convention: Every event node, including implicit-predicates and nested events, gets an author full-affirmative edge, with a source-specific modal edge for the reported content.

21.cause: The annotator linked the airstrike to an earlier event and a country entity, whereas gold links this 空袭 and the ordinal airstrikes to the earlier sentences' airstrike events as same-event.
21.convention: Repeated mentions of earlier airstrike events, including ordinal ones, are linked by :same-event to the corresponding earlier mention.

22.kind: Wrong root predicate: 离-02 used as the event instead of 相隔-01/隔-01 with distance as ARG1 and the two compared items as a conjoined ARG0
22.cause: The annotator took the preposition 离 as the main predicate and the measure verbs 相隔/隔 as modifiers of the distance quantity. The gold treats 相隔/隔 as the head, with the distance-quantity as ARG1 and the two compared locations or events as a coordinated ARG0.
22.convention: When a verb like 相隔/隔 ('be separated by') expresses the distance, it is the head predicate and the distance-quantity is its ARG1. The two things being compared are grouped in an 'and' as ARG0. The preposition 离 does not get its own predicate.

22.kind: Missing 'and' coordination of the two compared items (ARG0 of 相隔/隔)
22.cause: The annotator split the comparison into ARG0 and ARG1 of 离-02 rather than coordinating the two compared items under 'and'.
22.convention: Two entities or events that are compared or related symmetrically by a separation predicate are coordinated with 'and' as one argument.

22.kind: Event nouns 空袭 annotated as plain entities/concepts rather than as the event 空袭-01 with a performance aspect; 发生 was treated as the predicate
22.cause: The annotator used 发生-01 as the event with 空袭 as its ARG1, and left 空袭 as a bare concept without a sense number or aspect. The gold treats 空袭 as the event (空袭-01, :aspect performance) and 发生 as light, so it does not appear as a predicate.
22.convention: An event noun such as 空袭 is annotated as an event concept with a sense (空袭-01) and an aspect. A light verb such as 发生 ('occur') does not become the head. The event noun does.

22.kind: Elided first/third strike is not annotated as implicit-argument; the annotator wrote a full 空袭 with an ordinal instead
22.cause: The annotator reconstructed the elided noun (the first strike, 第一次) as a full concept 空袭. The gold marks it as implicit-argument carrying the ordinal, and places the third strike's :place-of 空袭-01 on an implicit-argument.
22.convention: Elided or implied referents are annotated as implicit-argument with the available modifiers (ord, place-of), not as a copy of the antecedent concept.

22.kind: Third 空袭 and 位置 structure: the second strike's 位置 is not shared between the two clauses; the annotator created a separate possessor 位置 with an extra ordinal
22.cause: In the second clause the annotator built a new 位置 with a possessor 空袭 carrying ord 2, instead of reusing the first clause's 位置 node (s22x6) in the 'and'. The gold reuses it by re-entrancy.
22.convention: A repeated referent within a sentence is represented by re-entrancy to the same node rather than by building a new node.

22.kind: Temporal relations: wrong anchors and missing after-relation between the two strikes
22.cause: The annotator chained 离-02 events with :overlap and anchored the first strike only to the document creation time. It missed the :after relation between the second and third strikes, and it did not anchor 相隔/隔 to the document creation time with :overlap.
22.convention: A stative predicate such as 相隔/隔 is anchored to the document creation time with :overlap. A sequence of ordinal events (second vs. third strike) gets an explicit :before/:after relation.

22.kind: Modal annotation: full-affirmative placed on the wrong nodes, missing on the third strike
22.cause: Because of the different graph structure, the annotator attached the modal to 离-02 and the 'and' node, and missed the third-strike event.
22.convention: Modal :full-affirmative attaches to the actual event and state predicates (the strikes and the 相隔/隔 states), not to prepositional or coordinating nodes.

22.kind: Coreference chains point to the wrong antecedents and the wrong nodes
22.cause: The annotator linked 空袭 nodes in this sentence to the explicit 空袭 nodes of s21, producing a chain with the wrong members. The gold links the sentence-22 events to the implicit predicates of s21 (s21i5, s21i6), which continue chains back to earlier 命中/袭击 events. The annotator also added an extra link for the possessor 空袭.
22.convention: Coreference links the event nodes in the current sentence to the matching event nodes of earlier sentences, including implicit predicates, so that the chain continues. Redundant nodes should not be created for repeated mentions.

23.kind: Wrong top-level structure: have-source-91 as root with contrast-91 instead of 'and' coordination with have-source-91 attached as :ARG1-of
23.cause: Annotator treated the 根据 phrase as the head and used contrast-91 for the 则 clause, instead of coordinating the two clauses with 'and' and attaching the source phrase to the coordination.
23.convention: A sentence-initial source phrase (根据 X) is annotated as have-source-91 attached via :ARG1-of to the coordinated main clauses; 则 does not by itself trigger contrast-91, so juxtaposed clauses are coordinated with 'and'.

23.kind: Passive 获 (receive/obtain) not annotated as an event; its predicate is dropped and 指定 is made the main event with the road as ARG1
23.cause: Annotator ignored the 获 passive auxiliary and attached the road to 指定-01 as ARG1/patient, whereas the gold has 获-01 with ARG0 road and ARG1 指定-01 event.
23.convention: Chinese 获/被-type passive constructions with a verbal complement are annotated as a 获-01 event whose ARG0 is the affected entity and ARG1 is the embedded event; the embedded event shares the entity as its ARG1.

23.kind: Road of first two attacks modeled with :place on road and a separate 地点 quant/mod; gold has road :place-of 地点 :place-of 遇袭 with have-frequency-91 on the event
23.cause: Annotator reversed the road/location relation and treated 头两次 as quant 2 and mod 头 on the location, not as the frequency (have-frequency-91 with ARG2 2 and ord 1) on the attack event.
23.convention: Counted occurrences like 头两次 ('first two times') are expressed on the event as have-frequency-91 with :ARG2 number and :ord ordinal-entity; the location noun is linked to the event via :place-of.

23.kind: Third-attack location clause: be-located-at-91 instead of have-place-91, and 旁边 given part-of 公路 instead of possessor road coreferent with the earlier 道路
23.cause: Annotator chose the wrong location predicate and made a new 公路 node with 这条 as a mod concept, missing that 这条公路 is the same road already introduced (reentrancy).
23.convention: Locative predication with 在 uses have-place-91; a 'this road' anaphor is resolved to the earlier referent via reentrancy, with the demonstrative not made a concept.

23.kind: Designation complement: 'accessible road for humanitarian aid' quoted gloss not modeled as identity-91 with a named concept; 可用 attached as ARG1-of with purpose on road rather than ARG0-of with purpose on 可用
23.cause: Annotator ignored the parenthetical English gloss as an identity-91 ARG2 and restructured 可用/援助 relations, giving the road a purpose and 可用 as passive ARG1-of.
23.convention: A parenthetical gloss/translation of a term is annotated via identity-91 whose ARG2 is the gloss concept; modifier verbs like 可用 are ARG0-of of the head noun, with purpose attached to that verb.

23.kind: Organization abbreviation OCHA treated as a named entity (name op1 'OCHA') rather than a concept; and org name tokenization differs (协调厅 not split into 协调 and 厅)
23.cause: Annotator wrapped OCHA in an international-organization name; gold treats the abbreviation as a plain concept (ocha) and splits 协调厅 into two name tokens.
23.convention: Name tokens follow the word segmentation of the source text/lexical units (here 协调 + 厅), and acronym glosses in parentheses are plain concepts under identity-91 rather than names.

23.kind: Temporal relations wrong: 指定 :before DCT and :after/overlap with 可用 and the attack/event relations differ; missing attack-before-designation and attack :overlap
23.cause: Annotator anchored 指定 to document creation time and made 可用 overlap with it, and linked the third attack to the location state, while gold puts the first attacks before the designation and designation after 可用.
23.convention: When one event is a precondition of another in the same sentence (attack, then designation), a :before relation holds between them; a state like 可用 ('accessible') that precedes the designation is :after-related.

23.kind: Modal: events attached under the source organization instead of author; and missing author full-affirmative on 获
23.cause: Annotator treated the 根据 source as a modal-scope holder, nesting every event under the OCHA organization, whereas the gold keeps all events directly under author with the org child only for the have-place event.
23.convention: A 根据 X source phrase does not create a new modal-scope node; events are full-affirmative directly under author.

23.kind: Coreference differences: spurious 道路 coref, missing event coref to earlier attacks, missing subset-of link, incomplete country chain
23.cause: Annotator linked the accessible-road concept to the gloss, linked the country only to the earlier mention (s4c), and did not link the attack events with previous sentences' attack events (same-event/subset-of).
23.convention: Repeated mentions of the same attack event or a subset of earlier attacks are linked via same-event/subset-of coreference across sentences; a country mention joins the full entity chain.

24.kind: Organization entity concept: annotator used international-organization for the Palestinian Red Crescent (gold: organization); and for the World Central Kitchen the concept matches gold but the relation differs
24.cause: Over-specific type choice for the named organization; gold uses generic 'organization' for the Red Crescent. The wrong-concept unit is on the Red Crescent/org slot.
24.convention: Use the generic 'organization' for named organizations unless clearly international in the gold; do not over-specify the named-entity type.

24.kind: Hospital annotated as a lexical concept 医院 with name, instead of named-entity type 'facility'
24.cause: Annotator kept the common noun as the concept rather than using a named-entity category for a named place/institution.
24.convention: Named institutions/buildings (hospitals) take a named-entity type concept such as facility with the name attached.

24.kind: Hospital name tokens split wrongly: 医院 omitted from the name (gold includes it); city name split into 代尔 拜莱赫 市 (gold uses single token 代尔拜莱赫 without 市)
24.cause: Annotator segmented the name by word and treated 市 as part of the name and 医院 as a generic head; gold includes the institution word in the name for facilities and keeps the place name as one token without the 市 suffix.
24.convention: Facility names include the institution word (医院); place names are kept as a single unsegmented token without the generic suffix 市.

24.kind: Protective modifier of 装备: annotator used bare noun 保护 with :mod, gold uses event 保护-01 with :purpose
24.cause: Annotator treated 保护 as a plain attribute noun rather than an eventive predicate with a sense, and picked :mod instead of :purpose.
24.convention: Eventive nouns/verbs modifying a thing to describe its function are annotated as events with sense id and linked via :purpose.

24.kind: Temporal adverb 最终 labelled :temporal instead of :mod
24.cause: Annotator used the semantically intuitive :temporal role, while gold uses :mod for this adverb.
24.convention: Adverbial modifiers like 最终 are attached with :mod.

24.kind: Organization relation to workers: annotator used :possessor, gold uses :part-of
24.cause: Misinterpretation of the 的 construction for membership/affiliation as possession.
24.convention: Affiliation/membership of a person with an organization is :part-of, not :possessor.

24.kind: Argument role of 不治身亡: annotator used :ARG1, gold uses :ARG0 for the dying workers
24.cause: Annotator treated the dying participant as patient/undergoer; gold treats it as ARG0 of the unaccusative-like compound.

24.kind: Temporal relations wrong: wearing equipment anchored to DCT rather than overlapping the transfer; transfer/rescue order (annotator: 移送 after 抢救? and rescue after death) differs from gold (transfer overlaps rescue... and before death)
24.cause: Annotator anchored the stative modifier clause (穿着) to document creation time and chose a different ordering between the transfer, the purpose-rescue and death events; the gold anchors the state to the main event and treats purpose event as overlapping the main event.
24.convention: State/modifier events overlap the main event they modify; purpose events overlap their main event rather than being strictly ordered; only the main event is anchored to DCT.

24.kind: Missing modal annotation for the 装备 entity-event (author full-affirmative 装备)
24.cause: Annotator did not give a modal annotation for 装备, which gold treats as an event node (it has :purpose event).
24.convention: Every event-like node in the graph gets a modal relation to author.

24.kind: Coreference errors: annotator linked the city to earlier mention (extra city chain) and linked workers/org to wrong antecedents; missed same-event link between 身亡 events across sentences and missed subset-of links from later sentences' 人员/雇员 to 工作者
24.cause: Annotator over-linked the city name to an earlier city mention, and did not link the death event to earlier mentions of the same death (身亡) event or establish subset relations for later groups.
24.convention: Repeated mentions of the same event (e.g., deaths) are linked with same-event; subsets of a previously mentioned group are linked with subset-of; do not link distinct places by name coincidence.

25.kind: Event concept uses the full verb-complement form instead of the base verb (运至-02 instead of 运-02)
25.cause: The annotator treated the verb together with its directional complement 至 as one predicate lemma instead of lemmatizing to the main verb and leaving the complement unexpressed as a separate concept.
25.convention: Name the event concept after the main verb alone; a directional or resultative complement is not merged into the predicate lemma.

25.kind: Wrong named-entity type for 加沙 (country-region instead of local-region)
25.cause: The annotator treated Gaza as a country-level entity, while the gold treats it as a sub-national, local region.
25.convention: Use local-region for named sub-national areas such as territories, strips, and districts, and country-region only for countries or national-level entities.

25.kind: Locative modifier relation: the location 南部 should attach to 医院 as :place with 南部 part-of the region; the annotator used :part-of from 医院 to 南部, which inverts the structure
25.cause: The annotator treated the phrase 'southern Gaza's hospital' as a part-whole relation between the hospital and the southern part, instead of treating the hospital as located in the southern part.
25.convention: A location noun phrase modifying an entity (X of region's Y) is expressed as :place on Y pointing to the location, not as :part-of from Y.

25.kind: Temporal relation anchored to the previous sentence's event instead of the document creation time
25.cause: The annotator inferred a narrative sequence with the preceding event 不治身亡 and linked to it, whereas the gold simply anchors the event to the document creation time.
25.convention: When there is no explicit temporal sequencing marker, anchor a past event to document-creation-time rather than chaining it to the previous sentence's event.

25.kind: Spurious coreference chain: 加沙 linked as same-entity to an earlier mention (s1g), which pulled later local-region mentions into a chain not in the gold
25.cause: The annotator marked repeated mentions of 加沙 as coreferent across sentences, but the gold does not include these chains.

25.kind: Missing subset-of coreference between 遗体 in the next sentence and 遗体 here
25.cause: The annotator did not link the later mention of 遗体 as a subset of this sentence's 遗体.
25.convention: When a later mention refers to part of a previously mentioned group or set of entities, mark it with :subset-of to the earlier mention.

26.kind: Compound word 原居国 split into 国 with mod 原居 instead of kept as a single concept
26.cause: Annotator decomposed the compound noun 原居国 into head + modifier instead of treating it as one lexical concept, as the gold does
26.convention: Chinese compound nouns that are lexicalized units are annotated as a single concept rather than being split into head and modifier

26.kind: Wrong named-entity type for 加沙地带 (country-region instead of local-region)
26.cause: Annotator picked country-region for Gaza Strip, whereas gold treats it as a local-region (a sub-national/geographic area)
26.convention: Sub-national or geographic regions (e.g. strips, areas within a territory) take the named-entity type local-region rather than country-region

26.kind: Wrong PropBank frame sense for 运回 (-02 instead of -01)
26.cause: Annotator chose roleset 运回-02 without matching to the PropBank sense used in gold (运回-01)
26.convention: Choose the PropBank roleset whose sense fits the usage; default to the first/only matching sense after checking the frame file

26.kind: Wrong aspect on 工作-01 (activity instead of performance)
26.cause: Annotator treated the modifier-like relative 'working' as an ongoing/habitual activity; gold marks performance for the event inside a nominal modifier
26.convention: Events embedded as modifiers of a noun (e.g. occupational descriptions) are annotated with aspect performance in this gold, rather than activity

26.kind: Wrong core role for the burying event's participant (ARG1 instead of ARG0)
26.cause: Annotator used ARG1 (patient) for 雇员 with 葬-00 (an unframed/undefined predicate); gold uses ARG0 for the participant of 葬
26.convention: For predicates lacking a PropBank frame (-00), the sole core participant is labeled ARG0 in the gold, as is the default for an agent/theme-subject without a frame

26.kind: Wrong temporal relation between the two contrasted events (overlap instead of after)
26.cause: Annotator assumed the contrasted clauses are simultaneous; gold orders 运回 after 葬

26.kind: Missing temporal relation between the date and the 工作-01 event
26.cause: Annotator did not annotate a temporal link for the embedded 工作 event; gold puts it before the date
26.convention: Events embedded in modifiers (e.g. prior occupation) still receive a temporal relation to the clause's time expression

26.kind: Wrong/missing coreference: annotator linked place to earlier mentions of the region and other chains; missed the entity-person chain and the 遗体 subset link
26.cause: Annotator over-generated identity coreference for the region (Gaza) with earlier sentences, and linked subsets to the wrong antecedent (s2w rather than the immediately preceding mentions s24/s25); it also missed the 遗体 subset-of link and the person chain to snt27
26.convention: Link a plural group/subset to its nearest antecedent group mention; mark subset-of for bodies of previously mentioned people; only mark identity coreference for genuinely the same referent in context

27.kind: Wrong top-level structure: 'and' with a separate :topic 遇难 event instead of include-91 with ARG1 the conjoined persons and ARG2 the 遇难者 set
27.cause: The annotator treated 遇难者 as a relative-clause event (遇难-00 with a bare 人 head) and made a flat 'and' of clauses. It did not model 'among the victims, 1 was..., 1 was...' as a part-whole include-91 relation with the 遇难者 as ARG2.
27.convention: Partitive 'N of the X: A, B, C' constructions are annotated as include-91 with ARG1 the conjunction of the members and ARG2 the whole set. A lexicalized agentive noun such as 遇难者 stays as a single concept and is not decomposed into an event plus 人.

27.kind: Members realized as identity-91 and 来自-01/具有-01 clauses with ARG0 人, instead of person nodes carrying the predicate through :ARG0-of
27.cause: The annotator made each clause a top-level event and attached the person as its ARG0. It also used identity-91 for the Palestinian person. The gold uses a person node with :quant and an :ARG0-of predicate.
27.convention: A person described by a predicate is a 'person' node with :ARG0-of the predicate. The English concept 'person' is used for 人, and a nationality is expressed by :mod country, not by identity-91.

27.kind: Used the lexical 人 instead of the 'person' concept
27.cause: The annotator kept the Chinese surface form for 人.
27.convention: 人 'person' is annotated with the English concept person.

27.kind: 原居 annotated as a single predicate 原居-00 with a :place argument; gold uses 居-02 with ARG1 the city and 原 as :mod
27.cause: The annotator treated 原居 as one word and used a place role. The gold splits it into the adverbial/modifier 原 and the verb 居 with the location as its ARG1.
27.convention: Productive prefix modifiers such as 原 are split off as :mod, and the location of 居 'reside' is its core ARG1.

27.kind: Place-name annotation differs: 加沙 typed as country-region instead of local-region; 拉法市 name includes 市 and the city type is not separated
27.cause: The annotator used a different entity type for Gaza and kept the generic suffix 市 inside the name. The gold names the city 拉法 only.
27.convention: Generic type suffixes such as 市 are excluded from the name tokens because the type is carried by the concept (city). Sub-national regions use local-region.

27.kind: Nationality annotated as 国籍 with a country name (and one node per nationality) instead of nationality concepts under an include-91 on 国籍
27.check: a_entity_concept; a_entity_found; d_core_args_event; d_core_args_abstract; d_peripheral_entity; f_name_tokens
27.cause: The annotator made 国籍 into a modified noun, with the countries as :mod country under a coordination. It also had 双重 as a :mod of the 'and'. The gold has 国籍 modified by 双重, and an include-91 whose members are nationality nodes with :name.
27.convention: A nationality is a 'nationality' concept with a :name, not a country. A dual-nationality noun is the ARG2 whole of an include-91 over the individual nationalities, and 双重 modifies the 国籍 noun.

27.kind: British humanitarian workers: modelled as a separate 服役 clause with the country as :mod, 名 as :unit, 遇难-00 and include-91 attached to the workers; gold nests the workers as ARG1 of an include-91 with the 另外 3 persons as ARG2, and has 服役 as :ARG0-of
27.check: d_core_args_abstract; d_peripheral_entity; a_entity_found; a_event_found; a_event_concept; e_core_labels; c_other_attributes
27.cause: The annotator promoted the subordinate 其中 clause to a top-level conjunct with 服役 as the main predicate. It made the workers an ARG0 with unit 名 and nationality :mod, and it added 遇难 as a relative event. Gold treats 其中 as an include-91 inside the 3-person group, and does not annotate 名 or the country here.
27.convention: 其中 'among them' is annotated as include-91 with the subset as ARG1 and the group as ARG2. The unit/classifier 名 is not annotated as a :unit. Modifiers recoverable from context are not repeated.

27.kind: Military unit name tokenization and :place country: the name includes the country (英国 皇家 海军 陆战队), and the annotator split it into a name plus a country place
27.cause: The annotator treated 英国 as a separate location of the organization, instead of part of the organization's full name.
27.convention: A country modifier that is part of an organization's name belongs in the name tokens and is not a separate :place.

27.kind: Temporal annotations: 来自/具有 anchored to the 遇难 event instead of present-reference; 居 and 服役 relations misanchored; extra 遇难 event relations
27.cause: Because 遇难 was annotated as an event, the annotator anchored the states to it with :overlap. Gold anchors the stative predicates to present-reference and the past predicates to the document-creation-time. The annotator also linked 服役 to its own 遇难 and include-91.
27.convention: Stative present-tense predicates (来自, 具有) are :overlap present-reference. Past events are :before document-creation-time. 遇难者 as a noun does not introduce an event.

27.kind: Extra modal annotations for the 遇难 event, include-91 and 原
27.cause: The annotator's extra event nodes (遇难, include-91, identity-91, and the split 原居) each got a full-affirmative modal relation.
